international.title: Black Friday deals for liquid Brazilian butt lifts criticised over safety fears
international.summary: Experts say BBLs and other cosmetic procedures can be risky and seasonal offers at clinics in England could make people rush decisions Clinics in England are promoting seasonal deals – including for Black Friday – on liquid Brazilian butt lifts (BBLs), despite concerns about the risks of the procedure. The government is consulting on limiting liquid BBLs , vampire facials and deep chemical peels in England to qualified healthcare professionals. Continue reading...
